name: Akros
description: Akros is a Spartan-inspired mountain polis on Theros, home to the plane's most feared warriors and under the patronage of the god Iroas.

description_citations.text: "The Walls of Akros" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Feb 2014.

summary.text: Akros is a Spartan-inspired mountain polis on Theros, home to the plane's most feared warriors and under the patronage of the god Iroas.

citations.text: "Akros". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"The Walls of Akros" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Feb 2014.

bio.text: It was founded by Elektes and six warriors, inspired by Iroas, after the war between humans and minotaurs, and Iroas established the Iroan Games there.

citations.text: "Akros", section "Birth of the poleis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Iroas", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Kytheon Iora, a gang leader from its slums who later became Gideon Jura, stole from the rich, fought harpies and cyclopes, and first planeswalked from Akros.

citations.text: "Akros", section "Kytheon Iora". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Akros", section "Kytheon Iora". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Gideon Jura", section "Adolescence". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Mogis sent minotaur hordes against human cities with Akros bearing the brunt, and the minotaurs built a wall around it and began a siege.

citations.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Born of the Gods
citations.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Born of the Gods". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jan 2014. Archived by the Internet Archive.
"The Walls of Akros" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Feb 2014.
"The Walls of Akros" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Feb 2014.

bio.text: Xenagos besieged it with minotaurs and was captured, and Queen Cymede offered herself to Keranos, who turned the Deyda River into an elemental that consumed the horde.

citations.text: "Akros", section "The rise and fall of Xenagos". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Akros", section "The rise and fall of Xenagos". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Cymede", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Elspeth led an army of heroes from Akros, Meletis and Setessa to break the siege, but Xenagos used the victory celebration for the Great Revel and ascended to godhood, and Elspeth was blamed and driven away.

citations.text: "Born of the Gods", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Akros", section "The rise and fall of Xenagos". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Born of the Gods", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: King Anax was impaled by Rhordon but saved by Elspeth, and he died within two years while Cymede was missing and their niece Taranika became regent.

citations.text: "Akros", section "The rise and fall of Xenagos". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Anax", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Akros", section "Uncertain succession". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Grieving planeswalkers later buried Gideon's breastplate outside Akros as a memorial.

citations.text: "Akros", section "Forsaken". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

status.text: During the Phyrexian invasion the gods and their devotees were compleated and Akros is presumed to have fallen.

citations.text: "Akros", section "Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Anax runs around the gymnasium and the palace grounds on the morning of the Setessans' audience.
timeline.quote: He ran past the rack of spears and swords

citation.text: "Prince Anax, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Sep 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: In the bathhouse, Timoteus mocks Anax, asking whether his plan is to run away when the Setessan army is bored of talking.
timeline.quote: When the Setessan army is bored of talking, is your plan to run away?

citation.text: "Prince Anax, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Sep 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The Setessan ambassador fails to reach an accord with King Athanas and hints they may take it up with his heir, Timoteus.
timeline.quote: We may take this up with your heir.

citation.text: "Prince Anax, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Sep 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Athanas declares that Anax is his eldest, and the ambassador seems unimpressed by Anax.
timeline.quote: This is Anax, my eldest.

citation.text: "Prince Anax, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Sep 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Athanas dismisses the ambassador as part of a council of cowards and vows to crush the Setessans if they come.
timeline.quote: But if they do, we will crush them.

citation.text: "Prince Anax, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Sep 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Athanas looks proudly at Timoteus and contemptuously at Anax in front of the soldiers.
timeline.quote: and he did nothing to conceal his contempt.

citation.text: "Prince Anax, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Sep 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Anax concludes in a lesson with Georgios that his father may not like him and that a king's choice of heir matters; Georgios hints a king could change the inheritance law.
timeline.quote: Does the king have the authority to change laws?

citation.text: "Prince Anax, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Sep 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Anax meets Zotikos in the gymnasium sand pit; Zotikos teaches him weight exercises and the apron-running drill.
timeline.quote: Plant your feet at shoulder width.

citation.text: "Prince Anax, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Sep 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Anax asks to meet Zotikos each evening, and Zotikos agrees after a calculating pause.
timeline.quote: Zotikos considered for a moment too long, and gave a calculating smile.

citation.text: "Prince Anax, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Sep 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Zotikos admits he helps Anax because he is the prince, wants to surpass his father's station, and thought Anax was looking for a friend.
timeline.quote: And it seemed like you were looking for a friend.

citation.text: "Prince Anax, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Sep 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Anax tells Zotikos to drop his titles in the gymnasium, where he is simply Anax.
timeline.quote: I am Anax.

citation.text: "Prince Anax, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Sep 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Georgios reminds Anax that the Iroan Games come in four months and he must compete; Timoteus has begun training for the pankration.
timeline.quote: the Iroan Games will take place in four months

citation.text: "Prince Anax, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Sep 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Anax resolves to attack boldly at his rival's strength and tells Zotikos he has some ideas.
timeline.quote: I have some ideas.

citation.text: "Prince Anax, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Sep 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Anax and Zotikos spar at the gymnasium; Zotikos beats him with an arm lock but cannot explain how.
timeline.quote: "Maybe I could help. Let's get everything out of the middle."

citation.text: "Prince Anax, Part 2". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Sep 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Georgios suggests the advisor Kaletor, a former pankration competitor, as a teacher.
timeline.quote: He competed in the pankration for several years.

citation.text: "Prince Anax, Part 2". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Sep 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Anax asks Kaletor to train him; learning Sinon trains his brother, Kaletor agrees with fire in his eyes.
timeline.quote: "In that case, I will be honored to help you."

citation.text: "Prince Anax, Part 2". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Sep 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Kaletor begins training Anax and Zotikos at night, teaching Anax to close and ground opponents and to use joint locks.
timeline.quote: Kaletor was true to his word, and began to teach Anax and Zotikos that very night.

citation.text: "Prince Anax, Part 2". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Sep 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Anax nearly cripples Zotikos with a kneebar and Kaletor confirms Sinon crippled him that way.
timeline.quote: "It was Sinon, wasn't it?"

citation.text: "Prince Anax, Part 2". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Sep 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Kaletor teaches the heel hook and makes Anax promise not to hurt anyone with it.
timeline.quote: Promise me you won't hurt anyone with it.

citation.text: "Prince Anax, Part 2". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Sep 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Anax wins his first two bouts of the junior pankration division before a packed stadium.
timeline.quote: Anax's first two bouts were easy.

citation.text: "Prince Anax, Part 2". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Sep 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Anax draws Timoteus, who opens with strikes; Anax closes and takes him to the ground.
timeline.quote: He grabbed his brother's kicking thigh and opposite shoulder and shoved, and like that the two were on the ground.

citation.text: "Prince Anax, Part 2". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Sep 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Anax baits Timoteus into the kneebar that crippled Kaletor, reverses it into a heel hook, and Timoteus submits.
timeline.quote: Timoteus went for it without a second thought.

citation.text: "Prince Anax, Part 2". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Sep 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Anax publicly rebukes Timoteus for trying to cripple him, winning the crowd's respect.
timeline.quote: But who would want to serve a king who crippled his own brother?

citation.text: "Prince Anax, Part 2". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Sep 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Anax loses his next bout but has won the crowd's respect.
timeline.quote: He lost his next bout to a tall young man who was about to come of age, and was stronger and more skilled.

citation.text: "Prince Anax, Part 2". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Sep 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Timoteus is publicly whipped for treason for trying to cripple his future king.
timeline.quote: King Athanas was furious with his second son, and had insisted.

citation.text: "Prince Anax, Part 2". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Sep 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The king tells Anax a marriage to Cymede is being arranged.
timeline.quote: We are considering a young woman named Cymede.

citation.text: "Prince Anax, Part 2". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Sep 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Elektes and six warriors, inspired by Iroas, found Akros after the war between humans and minotaurs.
timeline.quote: Elektes and six other warriors, inspired by the martial doctrine of Iroas , established the polis of Akros, with Elektes as its first king.

citation.text: "Akros", section "Birth of the poleis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The king of Olantin besieges Akros for decades after his queen leaves him for the Akroan king.
timeline.quote: What followed was a siege that stretched on for decades.

citation.text: "Akros", section "The Akroan War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Xenagos besieges Akros with minotaurs and the Akroans capture him.
timeline.quote: Queen Cymede informed them that the Akroans had captured the satyr Xenagos

citation.text: "Akros", section "The rise and fall of Xenagos". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Cymede offers herself to Keranos, who turns the Deyda River into an elemental that consumes the minotaurs; she ascends to Nyx.
timeline.quote: Cymede was claimed by Keranos as she transformed into a pillar of fire and crimson light and ascended into Nyx

citation.text: "Akros", section "The rise and fall of Xenagos". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rhordon, aided by Mogis, impales King Anax; Elspeth saves Anax, and Rhordon is washed away by the river.
timeline.quote: The Rageblood quickly defeated Anax by impaling the king through the stomach.

citation.text: "Akros", section "The rise and fall of Xenagos". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Xenagos uses the victory celebration to stage the Great Revel and ascend to godhood.
timeline.quote: Xenagos used the occasion to stage the Great Revel , the final ritual that propelled him to godhood

citation.text: "Akros", section "The rise and fall of Xenagos". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the Great Revel Anax dies, Cymede is missing, and their niece Taranika becomes regent.
timeline.quote: the responsibility of leadership fell to their niece, Taranika , who serves as regent

citation.text: "Akros", section "Uncertain succession". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Iroas establishes the Iroan Games in Akros to celebrate courage and athletic excellence.
timeline.quote: He established the Iroan Games in Akros to celebrate these ideals

citation.text: "Iroas", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After a Great Revel following the siege of Akros, Xenagos ascended to godhood as god of revels, and Elspeth was scapegoated for Daxos's death and exiled.
timeline.quote: Xenagos held the position of the god of the revels, furthering the chaos and distrust of the established pantheon.

citation.text: "Xenagos", section "Return to Theros". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Penthikos reaches Akros and tells the king what befell his fellows; the king sentences him.
timeline.quote: He heard my tale. He gave his orders. He pronounced my sentence.

citation.text: "Tragedy". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Oct 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Penthikos prays to the gods to expiate his hubris and is answered, freed from shackles.
timeline.quote: Let me expiate my hubris, O gods!

citation.text: "Tragedy". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Oct 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Pandamator is hailed as champion of the Iroan Games in Akros, and Iroas is asked to bless him.
timeline.quote: Now bless Thy child, Pandamator.

citation.text: "I Iroan". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Nov 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Mogis sends minotaur hordes against human cities, with Akros bearing the brunt.
timeline.quote: He began sending hordes of mortal and Nyxborn minotaurs against the human cities.

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Born of the Gods
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Born of the Gods". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jan 2014. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Elspeth leads an army of heroes from Akros, Meletis and Setessa to break the siege; the victory celebration becomes the ritual that launches Xenagos into Nyx as a god.
timeline.quote: the victory celebration after the battle became the ultimate ritual to launch Xenagos into Nyx as a god.

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Born of the Gods
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Born of the Gods". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jan 2014. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Pavios lies awake thinking of Thanasis, knowing his father plans to send him back to Meletis to marry an official's daughter in two days.
timeline.quote: Just two days hence, Pavios's father planned to send him back to Meletis to marry the daughter of a prominent official

citation.text: "Emonberry Red" by Clayton Kroh. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Feb 2014.

timeline.summary: Pavios hides a note for Thanasis telling him to search the coal pile for a gift.
timeline.quote: Pavios rolled up the note and placed it beneath a stone near the door to Thanasis's house.

citation.text: "Emonberry Red" by Clayton Kroh. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Feb 2014.

timeline.summary: Their fathers quarrel and the meetings end, and Pavios's father announces they will return to Meletis for the wedding.
timeline.quote: The following day, the disagreement between their fathers erupted

citation.text: "Emonberry Red" by Clayton Kroh. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Feb 2014.

timeline.summary: Thanasis speaks to Pavios through a crack in the wall at night and asks to meet at midday, thanking him for the gift.
timeline.quote: "I will wait for you," Thanasis said.

citation.text: "Emonberry Red" by Clayton Kroh. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Feb 2014.

timeline.summary: Mogis sends hordes of minotaurs against Akros, Meletis and Setessa.
timeline.quote: Mogis , the god of slaughter sends hordes of mortal and Nyxborn minotaurs against the human cities Akros , Meletis , and Setessa .

citation.text: "Born of the Gods", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth leads an army of heroes to break the minotaur siege at Akros.
timeline.quote: Elspeth Tirel leads an army of heroes to break the minotaur siege at Akros.

citation.text: "Born of the Gods", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The victory celebration becomes the ritual that launches Xenagos into Nyx as a god; Elspeth is blamed and driven away.
timeline.quote: Elspeth is blamed for his ascension and driven away in disgrace.

citation.text: "Born of the Gods", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Leandros runs for a day and more past fallen Alamon squads and minotaur bands and reaches Akros at night.
timeline.quote: Occasionally he came upon squads of fallen Alamon

citation.text: "The Walls of Akros" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Feb 2014.

timeline.summary: Leandros discovers the minotaurs have built a wall around Akros to keep the Alamon out while besieging the city.
timeline.quote: A wall. Someone— minotaurs —had built a wall around Akros

citation.text: "The Walls of Akros" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Feb 2014.

timeline.summary: Iroas and Mogis appear as stars above Akros and grapple, absorbed in their own conflict and not helping mortals.
timeline.quote: The twins were interested in each other, not mortals.

citation.text: "The Walls of Akros" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Feb 2014.

timeline.summary: Leandros falls to his knees, too late to prevent the siege of Akros, which begins.
timeline.quote: The siege of Akros had begun.

citation.text: "The Walls of Akros" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Feb 2014.

timeline.summary: Akroans defeat Mogis's minotaur horde and celebrate; Xenagos uses the occasion for his final ritual of ascension to godhood.
timeline.quote: Xenagos used the occasion to stage the final ritual that propelled him to godhood.

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Journey into Nyx
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Journey into Nyx". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2014. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: In a dream, Pollio ties twine to his family, customers and friends until the ropes grow tight and the crowd's flesh knits into a single mass; he wakes screaming.
timeline.quote: Then, Pollio was part of one amorphous mass of stinking flesh and burning rope

citation.text: "Dreams of the City" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Apr 2014.

timeline.summary: At the Akroan gates, hoplites revive the tactics of Kytheon Iora's irregulars.
timeline.quote: At the Akroan gates, hoplites revived the tactics of Kytheon Iora's infamous irregulars.

citation.text: Desperate Stand (Journey into Nyx, 2014), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Elspeth and Daxos travel to Akros, where Xenagos tells her how to destroy the army by raising the river.
timeline.quote: they raised the river that ran through Akros and swept the army away

citation.text: "Daxos", section "Journey into Nyx". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Daxos and Elspeth realize their feelings after the victory celebration.
timeline.quote: Daxos and Elspeth finally realized their feelings for each other

citation.text: "Daxos", section "Journey into Nyx". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Xenagos controls Elspeth, who kills Daxos while lashing out at the Phyrexian Obliterator in her memory.
timeline.quote: only realizing too late that she had just killed Daxos

citation.text: "Daxos", section "Journey into Nyx". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ajani realizes the latest Champion may be Elspeth, and Lanathos says she was seen at Akros, besieged by minotaurs.
timeline.quote: After she slew Polukranos, the Champion was spotted at Akros, which has been besieged by a horde of minotaurs.

citation.text: "Ajani, Mentor of Heroes" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Dec 2014.

timeline.summary: Kytheon and his irregulars work outside the law to bring justice to Akros.
timeline.quote: Kytheon and his irregulars worked outside the law to bring justice to the streets of Akros.

citation.text: Kytheon's Irregulars (Magic Origins, 2015), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Harpies descend on Akros and are met by javelineers.
timeline.quote: The harpies descended without mercy upon Akros, only to find their attack put them within range of the javelineers.

citation.text: Lightning Javelin (Magic Origins, 2015), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Kytheon Iora leads a gang stealing from the rich and is imprisoned, where Hixus teaches him hieromancy.
timeline.quote: The prison warden, a man named Hixus , taught him Hieromancy, the magic of order.

citation.text: "Akros", section "Kytheon Iora". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kytheon saves the Kolophon from harpies and cyclopes, defeats the titan of Erebos with Heliod's spear, then throws the spear at Erebos, who kills his irregulars; Kytheon first planeswalks to Bant and becomes Gideon Jura.
timeline.quote: Shocked and shamed by their deaths at his hand, Kytheon then made his first planeswalk to Bant, where he became known as Gideon Jura.

citation.text: "Akros", section "Kytheon Iora". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kytheon, a gang leader in the slums of Akros, steals from the rich to feed the poor.
timeline.quote: taking only what they needed to survive and giving the rest away to the poor

citation.text: "Gideon Jura", section "Adolescence". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Meletis blames Kedarick and declares support for the leonin mission to overthrow him; Akros and Setessa decline aid.
timeline.quote: Meletis formally declared its support for the Leonin mission to overthrow Kedarick

citation.text: "Kedarick VI", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Grieving planeswalkers bury Gideon's breastplate outside Akros as a memorial and Nissa grows an oak.
timeline.quote: Nissa Revane planted an acorn and grew it into a massive oak tree next to the stone

citation.text: "Akros", section "Forsaken". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Keranos circumvents the Silence of the Gods by sending prophetic visions to Queen Cymede, helping her destroy the minotaur army of Rhordon with a steam elemental.
timeline.quote: he circumvented the Silence by sending prophetic visions to Queen Cymede

citation.text: "Keranos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: As a reward for her faith, Keranos takes Cymede from Akros shortly before the Great Revel.
timeline.quote: Keranos took her from Akros shortly before the Great Revel

citation.text: "Keranos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Leandros's squad is sent to investigate after Eumalos's squad misses its checkpoint, and kills a charging cyclops.
timeline.quote: Leandros's squad was sent there to investigate

citation.text: "Leandros", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Leandros reaches Akros to find the minotaurs' siege already in progress.
timeline.quote: The minotaurs had built a wall surrounding the city, and he was unable to reach it.

citation.text: "Leandros", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Pavios moves to Akros, meets Thanasis, and they fall in love.
timeline.quote: Pavios met his neighbor, the blacksmith's son Thanasis, and they fell in love.

citation.text: "Pavios and Thanasis", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Thanasis gives Pavios his cloak and Pavios gives a short sword; Thanasis speaks of his mother's death and Pavios kisses him.
timeline.quote: Pavios comforted him with a kiss.

citation.text: "Pavios and Thanasis", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Their fathers forbid the meetings; Pavios sneaks a note and they agree to meet at the cliff.
timeline.quote: Their fathers then forbid them from seeing each other

citation.text: "Pavios and Thanasis", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Pavios, waiting at the cliff, sees a Fleecemane Lion kill a rabbit; it sees him and he flees into a gorge cave.
timeline.quote: Then the lion raised its head and saw him.

citation.text: "Pavios and Thanasis", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Pavios returns to find Thanasis dead against the emonberry tree, pierced by the sword he gave him.
timeline.quote: And then he saw Thanasis lying against the emonberry tree, his chest pierced by the sword Pavios had given him.

citation.text: "Pavios and Thanasis", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Pavios prays to Erebos, who promises they can be together in his realm; Pavios falls on his sword.
timeline.quote: And so, Pavios threw himself on his sword, and for a moment, he laughed.

citation.text: "Pavios and Thanasis", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Penthikos reports to the king of Akros, who sentences him to be chained to the rocks.
timeline.quote: And so he was chained to the rocks , to die in the sun of Heliod .

citation.text: "Penthikos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Penthikos prays for atonement and Erebos answers, freeing him to enter a cave.
timeline.quote: Erebos 's great voice filled the air, acknowledging his prayer

citation.text: "Penthikos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Humans and minotaurs wage war over the badlands; Iroas and Mogis and their champions fight, founding Akros and Skophos with Phoberos as border.
timeline.quote: This conflict resulted in the founding of Akros and Skophos

citation.text: "Phoberos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During the Phyrexian invasion, the gods and their devotees are compleated and Akros is presumed to have fallen.
timeline.quote: Akros is presumed to have fallen as a metropolis.

citation.text: "Akros", section "Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Aesrias sets out to tell King Anax of Tynthal's secession.
timeline.quote: His next quest would be to go to Akros to inform King Anax of Tynthal's secession

citation.text: "Aesrias", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Xenagos and his forces lay siege to Akros; Anax fights Rhordon, who is aided by Mogis, and is impaled.
timeline.quote: The Rageblood quickly defeated Anax by impaling the king through the stomach.

citation.text: "Anax", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth saves Anax and Rhordon is washed away by Keranos's river elemental.
timeline.quote: Elspeth stepped forward and saved Anax

citation.text: "Anax", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Anax insists the victory celebration continue, which Xenagos uses to become the Great Revel.
timeline.quote: This celebration was used by Xenagos to become the Great Revel he needed to ascend to godhood.

citation.text: "Anax", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Anax dies within two years, possibly of his injuries.
timeline.quote: He died sometime in the following two years, possibly due to his injuries.

citation.text: "Anax", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: With Cymede missing, Taranika serves as regent of Akros.
timeline.quote: the responsibility of leadership fell to their niece, Taranika

citation.text: "Anax", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Cymede offers herself to Keranos in exchange for his help during the siege of Akros; he turns the river into an elemental that consumes the minotaurs.
timeline.quote: Cymede offered herself to Keranos in exchange for his assistance.

citation.text: "Cymede", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth and Daxos arrive in Akros, which is besieged by Mogis's minotaurs, and meet the imprisoned Xenagos.
timeline.quote: They found the city encircled by Mogis’s minotaurs and a massive barricade cutting off reinforcements.

citation.text: "Great Revel", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Anax challenges Rhordon while Cymede and Daxos unleash the Deyda River with Keranos's might; Rhordon's horde is swept away and Anax wounded.
timeline.quote: Rhordon and his minotaur horde were swept away, but Anax was left grievously wounded.

citation.text: "Great Revel", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth and Daxos confess their love.
timeline.quote: Elspeth and Daxos at last confessed their love.

citation.text: "Great Revel", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Xenagos forces Elspeth to relive her trauma, and she kills Daxos; Sarpedon is also killed.
timeline.quote: Panicked, she struck down Daxos, realizing too late he was no monster.

citation.text: "Great Revel", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Xenagos feeds on the frenzied revel to breach Nyx and is crowned the new God of Revels.
timeline.quote: The mortals’ wild belief crowned him the new God of Revels amid chaos, carnage, and ecstatic dance.

citation.text: "Great Revel", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth flees with Nikka Takis to Heliod's shrine, denying Xenagos her sword.
timeline.quote: Elspeth, reeling, fled with Nikka Takis , who had safeguarded her sword

citation.text: "Great Revel", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At dawn Xenagos rises into Nyx; Elspeth is branded a traitor and vanishes into the wilderness.
timeline.quote: At dawn, Xenagos rose shimmering into the starry Nyx, leaving his mortal life behind.

citation.text: "Great Revel", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During the Birth of the Poleis, humans war with the minotaurs in Phoberos and the Katachthon Mountains; Iroas and Mogis reportedly fight over the land, resulting in the founding of Akros and Skophos.
timeline.quote: This conflict resulted in the founding of Akros and Skophos

citation.text: "Skophos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mortals endure and thrive on Theros behind the walls of great poleis, each a bulwark against raging monsters.
timeline.quote: each city-state a bulwark against the raging monsters that roam the more savage places of Theros.

citation.text: "Theros". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.
